entities.summary: The Church of St. Augustine and St. John the Baptist known colloquially as the  Norbertine Sisters Church is a historic Roman Catholic parish and conventual church of the Norbertine Sisters located at 88 Tadeusza Kościuszki Street, in Zwierzyniec the former district of Kraków, Poland.
